sys_script_include.description: Checks a blueprint before anything is written to the instance: 1. JSON Schema conformance 2. Referential integrity (every *_key points at something that exists, no cycles) 3. Platform fit (CI classes, roles and time zones exist on this instance) 4. Sanity (weights, counts, naming) Errors block a build; warnings are shown but do not.
sys_script_include.name: BlueprintValidator
